tool_schemas.name: getFileContents
tool_schemas.description: Reads and returns the contents and basic metadata for a single repository file at `path` for the workspace’s configured repository, optionally pinned to the provided git `ref` (otherwise the repository default branch is used). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `workspace_id` or parameters are malformed, FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to access the workspace/repository, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or the file/ref cannot be resolved, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id whose configured repository will be used.

path.description: Repository file path to read (relative to repo root).

ref.description: Git ref to read from (branch name, tag, or commit SHA); defaults to repository default branch if omitted.

tool_schemas.name: searchFiles
tool_schemas.description: Searches the workspace’s indexed repository files using `query` and optional filters (path_prefix, language, status, indexed time window), returning a page of matching file index entries sorted by `sort`/`order` up to `limit`; when more results exist, the response includes a `cursor` that you pass back to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters, time ranges, sort/order, limit, or cursor; FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized for the workspace/repository; NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist; and RATE_LIMITED when search quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id whose configured repository will be searched.

query.description: Full-text query to match against indexed file contents and metadata.

path_prefix.description: Only return files whose path starts with this prefix.

language.description: Only return files detected as this language.

status.description: Filter results by index entry status.

indexed_after.description: Only include index entries indexed at or after this timestamp.

indexed_before.description: Only include index entries indexed at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: searchIssues
tool_schemas.description: Searches the workspace’s indexed repository issues using `query` and optional filters (issue_state, issue_number, status, indexed time window), returning a page of matching issue index entries sorted by `sort`/`order` up to `limit`; when more results exist, the response includes a `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters (including out-of-range issue_number), time ranges, sort/order, limit, or cursor; FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized for the workspace/repository; NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist; and RATE_LIMITED when search quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id whose configured repository will be searched.

query.description: Full-text query to match against indexed issue title/body and metadata.

issue_number.description: Filter to a single issue number.

status.description: Filter results by index entry status.

indexed_after.description: Only include index entries indexed at or after this timestamp.

indexed_before.description: Only include index entries indexed at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: getCommitHistory
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of indexed commits for the workspace’s configured repository within the requested time window (by default the last `days`, or `since`/`until` when provided), optionally restricted by `path_prefix`, `author`, and `status`, and optionally including diff-focused fields when `include_diffs` is true; results are sorted by `commit_timestamp` and paged with `limit` and an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `days` is missing/out of range, timestamps are invalid or inconsistent, or limit/cursor/sort/order are invalid; FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized for the workspace/repository; NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist; and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id whose configured repository will be used.

days.description: Number of days back from now to include commits for.

path_prefix.description: Only include commits that touched files under this path prefix.

author.description: Only include commits whose author string matches this value.

since.description: Only include commits at or after this timestamp (overrides days if provided).

until.description: Only include commits at or before this timestamp.

status.description: Filter results by index entry status.

limit.description: Maximum number of commits to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of commits.

include_diffs.description: Whether to include diff-focused fields (e.g., files changed) in results.

tool_schemas.name: getWorkspace
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single workspace by `workspace_id` and returns its current configuration (including `configured_repo_id`) and lifecycle `status`. Refuses with FORBIDDEN if the API key is not in the workspace, VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist (or is deleted).

tool_schemas.name: updateWorkspace
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable workspace fields (e.g., name and configured repository) and/or performs workspace lifecycle transitions via `status`. Returns the updated workspace. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions or malformed fields, FORBIDDEN if not authorized, and rejects attempts to modify a deleted workspace.

configured_repo_id.description: Repository id to use as this workspace’s configured repository; set to null to clear configuration.

status.description: Workspace lifecycle state transition. Allowed: active→suspended/deleted, suspended→active/deleted.

tool_schemas.name: listRepositories
tool_schemas.description: Lists repositories visible to the caller within a workspace, with filtering by status and owner/name, returning a page of repositories sorted by `created_at` (default) unless `sort` is provided. Refuses with FORBIDDEN if not authorized for the workspace and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination/sort parameters.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id whose repositories will be listed.

github_owner.description: Filter by GitHub repository owner/org login.

limit.description: Maximum number of repositories to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: createRepository
tool_schemas.description: Creates a repository configuration under a workspace (GitHub owner/repo, default branch, installation type, and credential reference) to be indexed and searched. Returns the created repository. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed fields, FORBIDDEN if not authorized for the workspace, and CONFLICT if a non-deleted repository with the same owner/repo already exists in the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that will own the repository configuration.

default_branch.description: Default branch used when callers omit `ref`.

installation_type.description: How GitHub access is provisioned for fetching/indexing content.

credential_secret_ref.description: Reference to a stored secret containing the GitHub credential (e.g., vault path/secret id).

status.description: Initial repository status; defaults to active when omitted.

tool_schemas.name: updateRepository
tool_schemas.description: Updates repository configuration fields and/or performs repository lifecycle transitions via `status` (enable/disable/delete). Returns the updated repository. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions, attempts to change immutable identity fields in an unsafe way, or malformed fields; FORBIDDEN if not authorized; and rejects updates to deleted repositories.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the repository.

default_branch.description: Default branch used when callers omit `ref`.

credential_secret_ref.description: Reference to a stored secret containing the GitHub credential.

status.description: Repository lifecycle state transition. Allowed: active→disabled/deleted, disabled→active/deleted.

metadata.name: Private GitHub Search
metadata.description: This backend powers a private GitHub repository search service. It stores repository configuration, indexed snapshots of files/issues/commits, and logs each search/read request for auditing, rate limiting, and reproducibility of results over time. Repository: https://github.com/Hint-Services/obsidia
